mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_notifications ( recipient_member_id, actor_member_id, notification_type, resource_type, resource_id, rank_position, notification_event_key ) VALUES ( #{recipientMemberId}, #{actorMemberId}, #{notificationType}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{rankPosition}, #{notificationEventKey} )
mapper.select:
